title: Cozy Winter Coloring Book
sellingPoints: 50 bold and easy cozy winter coloring pages, one design per page
Cute polar bear, bunny, Santa Claus, gifts, chimney scenes, snowflakes, snowy trees and winter landscapes
Thick, clean outlines and big, simple shapes: easy for little hands, relaxing for grown-ups and seniors
10 printable book covers to make it a real book
Instant download, print at home as many times as you like
notes: Listing says 'for kids, teens, adults and seniors' with no age; owner set 5+, so the weekly batch writes to parents. The listing also pitches cozy evenings, Christmas break, classroom crafts and gifts for a coloring lover; mood line: a calm hour with hot cocoa while the snow falls. Seasonal: strongest from November to Christmas. Pages are 8.5 x 8.5 in square, so 'Hit print. It fits.' (8.5 x 11) does NOT apply. Listing's file list shows '2 PDF' while the description says PDF, PNG and JPG; say 'instant download' rather than naming PNG/JPG until the owner confirms. Personal use only. mockups/mockup-2.jpg is the cover; mockup-1.jpg is a page preview grid ('+43 more pages'); mockup-3.jpg shows six pages colored with different tools.
